title: HEAVY AND RAIDER ARMOUR IS CHIPPED AND STRIPED
why: Art build step b (his pick: Refined Chibi with Gear-heavy raider). The Heavy plates, the Big Pauldron and the Raider round pads now carry bare steel paint chips on their edges, the plates carry two scheme colour panel stripes, and the Big Pauldron gets a lower lip, a seam and three rivets. Everything stays inside the old outline, so no anchor moves. The spiked pad and the other vests stay clean.
now: Heavy and Raider armour now shows chipped paint and colour stripes.
